node_input.coordinate_units: projected metres, converted to kilometres for the structural ladder, consistent with the frozen source code dividing ecological distances by 1000
node_input.allowed_content: full coordinates and hydroperiod rows because both are frozen non-response inputs

founder_freeze.identity_resolution: resolve exact node IDs only after coordinate row order is frozen

analyst_choice_structural_axis.construction: minimum Euclidean centroid-distance threshold reaching each target largest weak component fraction; equal-distance ties admitted together
analyst_choice_structural_axis.interpretation: response-blind local-to-near-spanning analyst-choice scales, not biological dispersal limits

world_universe_at_gate1.reason: first test whether response-free geographic geometry brackets the refuge-scale founder-conditioned forecast; hydroperiod remains a later separately inspectable viability/persistence input

requirements: the 0.90 level must achieve largest weak component fraction >= 0.90
the 0.90 level must have isolated-node fraction <= 0.05
at least three distinct positive distance thresholds must exist across the four levels
thresholds and edge sets must be nested and deterministic
structural_adequacy_declaration.horizon_interpretation: maximum discrete propagation depth from 2003 through 2017; reported structurally but not used as a universal pass cutoff
structural_adequacy_declaration.stop_rule: if any declared requirement fails, stop before reading y.wide.dryad.csv response rows

next_if_pass: freeze node IDs, founder IDs, hydroperiod classes and structural fingerprints
freeze temporal calibration/holdout years from metadata only
freeze fixed-founder world rules, symmetric_world_support_summary_v1 and external comparators
only then open detection rows once
no_retuning: Do not add kNN worlds, change LCC targets, exclude remote candidate ponds, or use detections to alter the 274-node geometry after this declaration.
